public_rationale: The 80%/1% statistic appears in Ramp's business-spending research, but that is narrower than each provider's total revenue and customer population. Anthropic's filing supplies a different concentration measure, which cannot settle this one. The searches also did not establish that most of the relevant customers are AI startups spending three to ten times their revenue on tokens. The available evidence therefore does not settle the full claim.
limitations: A sample limitation is not proof that the full-population claim is false.
Concentration, customer classification and expenditure ratios require separate evidence.
The Anthropic filing was public by evaluation, although published after the post.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: 80% of Anthropic's and OpenAI's revenues come from 1% of their customers, the vast majority of which are AI startups that spend 300% to 1000% of their revenue on AI tokens.

statement.excerpt: The Revenues80% of Anthropic and OpenAI’s revenues come from 1% of their customers, the vast majority of which are AI startups that spend anywhere from 300% to 1000% of their revenue on AI tokens.

from_speaker: the vast majority of which are AI startups
300% to 1000% of their revenue on AI tokens
our_interpretation: The plain reading concerns each provider's total realized revenue and its own paying customers, rather than only business payments visible through one financial platform.
Use July–September 2026, the latest completed calendar quarter before the post, because no measurement period is specified.
Vast majority refers to a clear predominance by customer count within the high-spending group; no precise percentage is supplied.
The spending ratio compares actual token expenditure with the same startup's realized revenue over the same period.
The surrounding argument invokes external spending estimates, so estimate is the applicable basis.
criteria.support_condition: Matched customer-level data establish approximately 80% of each provider's total revenue from its top 1% of customers, show that a clear predominance of those customers are AI startups, and establish token expenditures of three to ten times their same-period revenue.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable full-population data materially conflict with the 80%/1% concentration, the customer classification, or the three-to-ten-times spending ratios. A narrower sample or a different concentration statistic alone does not establish contradiction.
